answer: We formulate a Sybil-resistant mechanism using a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function alongside a dynamic opportunity-cost staking collateral. If an adversary spins up multiple identities to whisper fraudulent state transitions within the nebula of decentralized nodes, the subgame-perfect slashing penalty triggered by a deviation delta guarantees that the expected utility of attack remains strictly negative. Consequently, the unique Nash equilibrium converges to honest execution, proving that the capital barrier of identity multiplication yields no economic advantage.
